title: Flight Centre hacked: check if you've booked
message: Flight Centre says hackers got into a hotel booking system it uses, also used by Travel Associates and Cruiseabout. Customer details, including some passport details, may have been taken. Card and bank details aren't affected so far, and flight bookings aren't affected. If you've booked with them, watch for their email. Don't click links in any booking, refund or passport message: contact them directly instead.
